announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.6.1 — perbaikan penting: Gemini yang berputar lama lalu gagal membuat gambar di Mode Cerita (arsitektur + model) sudah diperbaiki, begitu juga "Gagal Kirim — Prompt belum masuk utuh" saat memakai catatan area bernomor. Juga: jendela Log dan Proyek di tab Gemini tidak lagi terpotong, dan ukuran halaman Gemini kembali normal. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.6.1 — important fix: Gemini spinning for minutes and then failing to create an image in Story Mode (architecture + model) is fixed, and so is "Send failed — prompt not fully entered" when numbered area notes are used. Also: the Log and Project windows on the Gemini tab are no longer cut off, and the Gemini page is back to normal size. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
